info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Rules-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules Retrieval API enables consumers to access and review the rules governing hotel loyalty points accumulation and redemption. This endpoint provides vital information about the criteria and conditions under which points are earned, assisting customers in making informed decisions about their loyalty programs. Typically utilized by hotel management systems, customer service platforms, and third-party loyalty integration solutions, this API enhances user engagement through transparent communication of loyalty benefits. Developers can leverage this API to ensure their applications offer users accurate and up-to-date loyalty points information.

get.summary: Retrieve the rules related to points.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current rules governing point allocation and usage. It is essential for understanding how points are earned, redeemed, and any restrictions that may apply.
